adjustments.label: 40+ yard bonuses
adjustments.note: Yahoo awards +1 per 40+ yd completion/run/reception and +2 per 40+ yd TD. TapThatDraft has no field for these, so explosive players are undervalued on the base board.

adjustments.label: Yardage milestones
adjustments.note: +2 at 350 passing / 150 rushing / 150 receiving yards in a game. Rewards weekly spike scorers over steady floors.

adjustments.label: Distance-based kicker scoring
adjustments.note: Kickers score 10 yards per point instead of flat per-range values, which makes long-leg kickers meaningfully more valuable than the base board assumes.
